title: McpLocalShellCall
description: Arguments object for the tempOS MCP stdio `tempos.local_shell` tool. The caller supplies proposed command metadata only; daemon admission, lease, sandbox, and receipt evidence remain authoritative.

command.description: PATH-resolved command name. Slash-containing paths are refused so the gateway resolves executable identity from the sandbox-safe PATH.

cwd.description: Workspace directory to canonicalize before admission and sandbox execution.

env.description: Optional non-secret BEATER_* variables layered over the gateway's safe sandbox PATH. PATH, inherited process environment, and BEATER_* names that look like tokens, secrets, keys, passwords, auth, bearer, or credentials are never accepted.

max_output_bytes.description: Per-call sandbox stdout/stderr collection cap. The runtime additionally refuses values above SandboxLimits::default().max_output_bytes.

max_model_output_bytes.description: Per-call cap for the model-visible text fallback. The runtime additionally refuses values above the server-configured maximum, which defaults lower than this schema-wide ceiling.
